caption: The drawing depicts a richly detailed, ornamental wall plaque or frame, rendered primarily in shades of brown with white highlights suggesting carved patterns and ornamental flourishes. The plaque is shaped with a curved and scalloped outline, and is suspended by two black twisted cords or chains connected to loops at the top. At the upper center is a carved representation of a bear’s head. The plaque’s surface is decorated with intricate lighter-colored scrollwork and geometric designs. Four round medallions, possibly bearing human or classical faces in relief, are situated at the corners of the plaque. The most prominent feature is a circular central medallion or inset, colored in sepia tones, depicting two human figures and a large bird, possibly an angel or a person with wings, in a nature setting with foliage. The name "Beverly Chichester" is written in the lower right corner of the paper, outside the plaque, indicating the artist's signature. The background is a plain, light beige color with some scattered small stains or marks.
title: Wall Pocket
